enchantments.tooltip: +7 Enhancement Bonus: +7 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Improved Bashing: This shield does an additional 2 to 12 damage when used to shield bash.
Shield Bashing +20%: +20% Enhancement bonus to your chance of a Secondary Shield Bash. This stacks with bonuses granted by any relevant feats.
Damage Reduction 15/Piercing: Reduces physical damage by 15, except from Piercing attacks.
Sheltering +12: +12 Enhancement bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings
